overview_description.description:
Billforward develops and sells cloud based unified billing applications for businesses in the United States. Its applications comprise features, such as invoice and subscription aggregation, fixed and variable term subscriptions, offline and online payments automation, in-advance and arrears payment cycles, and smart payment gateway routing. 

Billforward offers solutions for enterprise billing; marketplace, reseller, and partner billing; subscription and one-time self service billing; product, market, and departmental unified billing; and SaaS and on-premise deployment. It serves customers in food tech, cloud-based software, delivery technology, and telecommunications industries. 

Aubone Tennant, Ian Saunders, and Mark Parry founded Billforward in 2014. It has its headquarters in San Francisco in California.
